driverChat.greeting: Hey, it's {driver}! 🛵 I've got your {store} order and I'm on the way. Let me know if you need anything!

replies: I'm about {eta} away — hang tight! 🛵
Should be roughly {eta} out, moving as fast as I safely can!
Around {eta} to go. Almost there!
Just a few streets away, following the map to you now.
I'm close! Pulling into your area shortly.
Almost on your road — I'll ping you when I'm right outside. 📍
Don't worry, it's sealed up and riding safely in the insulated bag! 🔒
Keeping it flat and warm the whole way — it'll arrive in great shape.
Handling it with care, promise. It'll be just as good as it left the kitchen!
Got it — I'll follow those instructions exactly. 👍
Understood! I'll do just that when I arrive.
No problem, noted! I'll handle the drop-off the way you asked.
I can't change the order from the road, but the app's Help section can sort that out for you.
Sorry, the order's already packed and with me — best to raise that in the app so support can help.
That's out of my hands once I've picked it up, but support in the app can take care of it!
You're welcome! 😊 See you in a bit.
Anytime! Happy to help. 🙌
No problem at all — enjoy your meal!
That's really kind of you, thank you! 🙏 You can add a tip in the app after delivery.
Aw, appreciate the thought! Tips can be added in the app once I've dropped off.
You're too kind! No pressure at all — but thank you! 😊
Hey there! 👋 Everything's on track with your order.
Hi! 🛵 On my way to you now.
Hello! Your food's with me and heading your way.
See you soon! 🛵
Catch you at the door! 👋
Talk in a bit — almost there!

fallback: Got it! 👍 I'll keep that in mind.
No worries — I'm on my way with your order. 🛵
Understood! Let me know if there's anything else.
